versions.changelog: Fixed water shattering at low zoom, where simplification had fattened narrow streams into slivers far wider than the real watercourse, and rebuilt land use alongside so the layers stay aligned.
Corrected the English romanization of city and neighborhood names using authoritative Japanese reading data, fixing many names that automated transliteration had misread.

Reworked commuter-to-workplace matching to reproduce census commute totals exactly and even out block-to-block variation; recomputed map geometry in the map's local projection for a lighter download and wider default view.
Restored dropped coastal and island neighborhoods, thinned over-drawn building foundations, and back-filled sparse building footprints.
Added per-building foundation depth, Global Building Atlas heights and 3D buildings, fuller land use, and military demand; widened metropolitan boundaries.
Added university, zoo, aquarium, and botanical-garden demand; rebalanced population and improved point placement.
Initial release of the Toyama map with census-based residents and workers, commute demand, and port, hospital, and school demand.
